verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own marketing describes built-in AI that assists teams, summarizes conversations and automates repetitive work, plus AI agents that update CRM records autonomously and book meetings. So a built-in assistant capability exists, but the evidence is high-level marketing copy and does not show how a user hands tasks to it. Missing for 10: documentation of a user-facing assistant interface for delegating arbitrary tasks, detail on its scope and controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI to assist teams, summarize conversations, automate repetitive work, support next-best actions, and improve execution using real customer context.
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
Monitor, manage, and optimize your credits to get the best value from your AI agents.
Automatically book meetings using real-time availability and predefined business rules
